quote: Alcuni detenuti gestiscono l’approvvigionamento con l’impiego di droni in grado di trasportare plichi, al cui interno viene occultato stupefacente, cellulari, coltelli e tirapugni
quote_translation: Some detainees manage supply using drones able to carry parcels in which drugs, phones, knives and knuckle-dusters are hidden

summary: Ronanstown Gardaí and Operation Throwover searched a Clondalkin residence and seized a drone and a package wrapped for conveyance holding cannabis, cocaine and diamorphine, plus mobile phones. One man in his 50s was arrested and released; file to DPP.
payload_detail: cannabis ~€2,300, cocaine €675, diamorphine >€4,000 street value; mobile phones
source_title: Gardaí seize over €6,795 worth of drugs and drone in Clondalkin, Dublin, Friday 24th October 2025
quote: A domestic residence was searched and as a result a drone along with a package wrapped for conveyance were seized.

place: Sevilla I prison, Alcalá de Guadaíra
summary: A drone flew to the cell windows of Sevilla I and released a bag that fell in a module yard, where a person collected it. Video was posted on social media. Reported about a week before 16 October 2025.
source_title: Interior gastará cuatro millones de euros para proteger las prisiones españolas de los asaltos de drones
quote: El dron desprendió una bolsa que cayó al patio de unos de los módulos. Una sombra estaba esperando el paquete y se lo llevó.
quote_translation: The drone released a bag that fell in the yard of one of the modules. A shadow was waiting for the package and took it.

place: Brians 1 prison, Sant Esteve Sesrovires; arrest at Masquefa (Anoia)
summary: Mossos d'Esquadra arrested a 32-year-old man at Masquefa after a pilot detection system logged six unauthorised drone flights over Brians 1; same drone seen again 19-20 September. Parcels with hashish, cocaine and electronics were found in a yard.
payload_detail: hashish, cocaine and electronic material (mobile phones per article lead)
source_title: Detenido por entrar móviles y drogas con un dron en la cárcel de Brians 1
quote: los Mossos d'Esquadra han detenido a un hombre que había hecho llegar móviles y drogas a la cárcel de Brians 1 con este método.
quote_translation: the Mossos d'Esquadra have arrested a man who had delivered mobile phones and drugs to Brians 1 prison by this method.

summary: Drone carrying a large parcel found in the grounds of HMP Berwyn; parcel contained mobile phones, chargers and herbal drugs. Police seized drone and parcel. No arrests reported. Two vehicles burned in staff car park on 29 September, link not stated.
payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, herbal drugs
source_title: Drone carrying contraband seized at HMP Berwyn grounds
quote: The parcel was x-rayed and was found to contain a quantity of mobile phones, chargers, and herbal drugs.

summary: Prison sources and the guards' union reported drones overflying Lisbon prison for two consecutive weeks. A parcel with high-end phones, chargers and memory cards dropped by a drone was recovered in the early hours of Friday 12 September.
payload_detail: high-end phones, chargers and memory cards
source_title: Drones sobrevoam prisão de Lisboa há duas semanas e deixam embrulho
quote: Há duas semanas consecutivas que o Estabelecimento Prisional de Lisboa (EPL) é sobrevoado por drones, que depois desaparecem sem deixar rasto.
quote_translation: For two consecutive weeks Lisbon Prison (EPL) has been overflown by drones, which then disappear without trace.

summary: Prison officers seized two drone-dropped packages on 6 and 10 Sept 2025 containing tablets, heroin, fob phones and chargers. A prison source says drones burn through yard netting and then drop packages.
payload_detail: tablets, heroin, fob phones, chargers; 'thousands of euros'
source_title: Exclusive: Drones used to burn Limerick Prison yard netting for drug drops
quote: Prison officers seized packages on September 6 and 10 before they could get into criminals’ hands.

summary: PSP stopped a man placing phones, chargers and drugs into Lisbon prison by drone in the early hours of Thursday. The aircraft was painted black and flew without lights. The operator escaped the officers.
payload_detail: phones, chargers and drugs
source_title: PSP impede tráfico de telemóveis e droga por drone na cadeia de Lisboa
quote: A PSP impediu um homem de colocar artigos ilegais (telemóveis, carregadores e droga) a partir de um drone, na madrugada de quinta-feira, no interior da prisão de Lisboa.
quote_translation: The PSP stopped a man from placing illegal items (phones, chargers and drugs) from a drone, in the early hours of Thursday, inside Lisbon prison.

summary: Member of parliament states the prison was overflown 23 times by drones overnight 19-20 August 2025. Claim made in a written parliamentary question, not an official count.
source_title: Question écrite n° 9618 : Installation de filets dans les prisons pour lutter contre les drones
quote: dans la nuit du 19 au 20 août 2025, la prison de Varennes-le-Grand a été survolée 23 fois par des drones
quote_translation: in the night of 19 to 20 August 2025, Varennes-le-Grand prison was overflown 23 times by drones.

summary: A young man from Gleizé flew 194 trips to Villefranche remand prison between 6 and 26 July; tracked home by following the drone. Sentenced to 2 years; jailed after the hearing.
source_title: Près de Lyon : depuis son immeuble, le pilote de drone livrait des dizaines de colis aux détenus chaque jour
quote: 194 voyages jusqu'à la maison d'arrêt de Villefranche entre le 6 et le 26 juillet
quote_translation: 194 trips to Villefranche remand prison between 6 and 26 July.

summary: Counter-drone operation at HMP Wandsworth recovered a drone described by the Ministry of Justice as sophisticated, costing GBP 6,000, 40-minute flight time, able to carry four loads. Combined with HMP Manchester operation, nine arrests.
source_title: Counter-drone efforts rise as prison sightings revealed
quote: The clampdown has already seen counter-drone operations at HMPs Manchester and Wandsworth

summary: Police special-purpose officers found a drone that fell into the Mostar prison yard with a mobile phone, a USB cable and several bags of a suspected drug glued to its body, and stopped the operator retrieving it; operator unidentified.
payload_detail: phone, USB cable, bags of suspected drugs (quantity not stated)
source_title: Zatvorenik dronom naručio mobitel i drogu, letjelica s paketićima pala u zatvorsko dvorište
quote: Pripadnici policije spriječili su u nedjelju navečer gotovo filmski pokušaj krijumčarenja narkotika i mobitela dronom u zatvor u Mostaru, izvijestilo je u ponedjeljak Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Hercegovačko-neretvanske županije.
quote_translation: Police on Sunday evening prevented an almost cinematic attempt to smuggle narcotics and a mobile phone by drone into the prison in Mostar, the Interior Ministry of Herzegovina-Neretva Canton reported on Monday.

summary: A drone carrying a viable pipe bomb crashed into the garden of a family home in Finglas, apparently meant for a rival criminal's house, and did not detonate. Gardaí link it to a feud over the drugs trade and searched eight residences on 8 May, seizing a shotgun, ammunition, cannabis, heroin.
payload_detail: viable pipe bomb
source_title: Finglas bomb attack (RTE News, 6 May 2025; page headline not captured)
quote: A drone carrying the improvised explosive device, which gardaí believe was targeting a criminal's house in the area, crashed into the home of an innocent family in Glenties Park in the early hours of yesterday morning.

summary: Security guards at Mas d'Enric prison saw lights of drones, possibly up to six, over the restricted airspace of the prison during the second half of a football match on the evening of Saturday 3 May 2025. No delivery or arrest reported.
source_title: Alerta en la cárcel de Tarragona por la presencia de drones ilegales en su espacio aéreo
quote: los guardias de seguridad de la cárcel de Tarragona advirtieron que, sobre el espacio aéreo del centro penitenciario
quote_translation: the security guards of Tarragona prison noticed that, over the airspace of the prison

place: Wheatfield and Cloverhill prison campus, Clondalkin, and west Dublin search (per Irish Times)
summary: Gardaí learned of an attempted drone delivery to a prison and searched a west Dublin house under warrant. A drone and electronic devices were seized. Four men were arrested and released without charge; file to DPP.
source_title: Operation Tara - Search and Arrest Operation in West Dublin, 20th April 2025
quote: Gardaí from Ronanstown Garda Station became aware of an attempt to carry out a drone delivery to a prison yesterday, Sunday 20th April 2025.

place: Clondalkin, Ballyfermot, Coolock, Tallaght (Dublin) and Mountjoy Prison cells
summary: Gardaí searched properties in four Dublin districts and cells in Mountjoy in an investigation into smuggling into Wheatfield, Cloverhill and Mountjoy. Seized: miniature phones packed for drone delivery, a drone, drugs, €22,000 cash, improvised weapons.
payload_detail: cannabis €17,000, cocaine €5,000, tablets €3,000; €22,000 cash; miniature phones
source_title: An Garda Síochána searches conducted as part of investigation into smuggling of controlled drugs and contraband into Irish prisons, Tuesday 8th April 2025
quote: During the searches of these properties, a number of miniature phones wrapped in insulation tape ready to be sent by drone to the prisons were seized.

summary: Prison police intercepted a drone over the detention areas of Foggia prison on the evening of 10 March 2025 and recovered a package of about 500 g hashish and cocaine, SIM cards and other prohibited items. The drone was downed with a jammer rifle.
payload_detail: ~500 g hashish and cocaine, SIM cards, other items
source_title: Droni Illegali sulle Carceri italiane: due successi per le autorità (e forse qualcosa sta cambiando)
quote: l’intervento, avvenuto nella serata del 10 marzo 2025, è stato reso possibile grazie alla prontezza degli agenti, che sono riusciti a intercettare il velivolo mentre sorvolava gli spazi detentivi e a recuperarne il carico
quote_translation: the operation, on the evening of 10 March 2025, was made possible by the officers' readiness, who intercepted the aircraft while it flew over the detention areas and recovered its load

summary: Staff at Wheatfield Prison intercepted a drone delivery and seized a large quantity of contraband, including drugs and mobile phones, per an Irish Prison Service social media post reported on 16 Mar 2025. No arrests stated.
payload_detail: 'a large quantity of contraband'; drugs and mobile phones pictured
source_title: Drone 'intercepted' delivering 'large quantity' of drugs and mobile phones to Irish prison
quote: Earlier today staff at Wheatfield Prison intercepted a drone delivery into the prison that resulted in the seizure of a large quantity of contraband

summary: After prison officers noticed movement around Taranto prison, the Questura's Squadra mobile found in thick vegetation a few hundred metres from the perimeter a medium drone with a fishing-line-tied packet: four hashish blocks (~100 g), three marijuana doses, ~4 g cocaine and a smartphone with earphones and SIM.
payload_detail: ~100 g hashish, 3 doses marijuana, ~4 g cocaine, smartphone + SIM
source_title: Droni Illegali sulle Carceri italiane: due successi per le autorità (e forse qualcosa sta cambiando)
quote: recuperato e sequestrato un drone di medie dimensioni al quale era stato legato con una lenza un piccolo pacchetto di plastica con all’interno quattro panetti di hashish per un peso complessivo di circa cento grammi
quote_translation: recovered and seized a medium-sized drone to which a small plastic packet had been tied with a fishing line, containing four hashish blocks weighing about one hundred grams in total

summary: A large drone reportedly rated to lift 130 kg, apparently carrying a rope and harness, hovered over the Nivelles prison yard in an alleged attempt to free an inmate. No escape occurred. The drone was later found in a car in Brussels; the main suspect was remanded in custody.
payload_detail: rope and harness; 18.5 g hashish and one phone found on prison ground, no formal link established
source_title: `Drone` gigante utilizado em tentativa de fuga de prisão na Bélgica
quote: A tentativa de fuga aconteceu em 25 de fevereiro, quando alguns moradores da cidade ouviram um forte barulho perto da prisão
quote_translation: The escape attempt took place on 25 February, when some residents of the town heard a loud noise near the prison.

summary: State Police saw a drone with a small package heading for the prison territory at about 15:00 in daylight and brought it down by taking control. Two pilots, over 500 m away, were found and fined about EUR 2,000 administratively because delivery failed. Police linked them to the criminal world.
payload_detail: small package for inmates; contents not stated
source_title: Pārtver drona veiktu piegādi Rīgas centrālcietumam
quote: Gaišā dienas laikā, ap pulksten 15 likumsargi pamanīja dronu, kas virzījās uz Rīgas centrālcietuma teritoriju. Bija redzams, ka pie drona piestiprināta neliela paciņa.
quote_translation: In daylight, at about 15:00, law enforcers noticed a drone heading toward the Riga Central Prison territory. A small package was visibly attached to the drone.

summary: Neighbourhood officers on patrol followed two men to the walls of HMP Hindley and seized a drone. Two men in their 20s arrested on suspicion of conspiracy to convey prohibited articles into prison; bailed.
source_title: Two men arrested after drone spotted flying at HMP Hindley
quote: Officers believe the suspects were trying to smuggle illegal contraband into the prison's grounds.

place: Piedruja parish, Krāslava municipality, border zone
summary: Daugavpils border guards found a drone in the border zone in Piedruja parish and, nearby, a box of contraband cigarettes wrapped in black polyethylene: 10,000 NZ Gold with Belarusian excise stamps. Drone seized; criminal proceedings opened for smuggling in a significant amount.
payload_detail: 10,000 NZ Gold cigarettes with Belarusian excise stamps
source_title: Robežsargi izņem 10 tūkstošus kontrabandas cigarešu un dronu
quote: Valsts robežsardzes Daugavpils pārvaldes robežsargi Piedrujas pagastā, pierobežas joslā, konstatēja bezpilota gaisa kuģi (dronu), bet teritorijas apskates laikā netālu no drona konstatēja melnā polietilēna plēvē ietītu kārbu ar kontrabandas cigaretēm.
quote_translation: Daugavpils border guards in Piedruja parish, in the border zone, detected an unmanned aircraft (drone) and during a survey of the area near the drone found a box of contraband cigarettes wrapped in black polyethylene film.

summary: Gendarmerie cyber unit dismantled a family-run paid drone-delivery service for inmates, directed from inside the prison; seven arrested on 22 June 2026, 20,500 euro seized. Deliveries charged 150 euro per drone.
payload_detail: alcohol, food, cigarettes, narcotics, phones, computer connectors
source_title: Démantèlement d’une structure criminelle de livraison par drone en centre pénitentiaire par les cyberenquêteurs de l’UNCyber
quote: L’organisation du groupe est similaire à celle des organisations criminelles classiques, avec une répartition des tâches entre les membres d’une équipe
quote_translation: The group's organisation resembles classic criminal organisations, with tasks divided among team members.

place: Messina (drone fell in Gazzetta del Sud premises; suspected target Gazzi prison)
summary: A drone lost orientation and fell into the Gazzetta del Sud garden in Messina at night (Tue-Wed before 2 Feb 2025), still carrying on a fishing line a packet with two analogue phones, about 100 g hashish and 20 g cocaine. Suspected destined for an inmate at Gazzi prison.
payload_detail: 2 analogue phones, ~100 g hashish, 20 g cocaine
source_title: Droga e telefonini nelle celle, indagini sulla rete dei contatti (Gazzetta del Sud, 2 Feb 2025; clipping PDF)
quote: La notte tra martedì e mercoledì il clamoroso ritrovamento di un drone che, perso l’orientamento, è caduto nel giardino interno dello stabilimento di Gazzetta del Sud.
quote_translation: On the night between Tuesday and Wednesday, the striking discovery of a drone that, having lost its bearings, fell into the inner garden of the Gazzetta del Sud plant.

summary: A drone crashed at the Berlin juvenile prison after overflying it, carrying narcotics. A criminal complaint was filed; no suspect was identified.
payload_detail: Betäubungsmittel (quantity not stated)
source_title: Schriftliche Anfrage 19/25115: Drohnenüberflüge und Schmuggel in Berliner Justizvollzugsanstalten (Antwort)
quote: In dem Fall der abgestürzten Drohne in der Jugendstrafanstalt Berlin wurde eine Strafanzeige erstattet; ein Tatverdächtiger konnte nicht ermittelt werden.
quote_translation: In the case of the crashed drone at the Berlin juvenile prison a criminal complaint was filed; no suspect could be identified.

summary: Švenčionys border guards heard and thermally imaged a home-made unmanned aircraft from Belarus, brought it down with anti-drone equipment and found just over 600 packs of Minsk City QS cigarettes with Belarusian stamps and a GPS transmitter attached.
payload_detail: just over 600 packs Minsk City QS cigarettes, GPS tracker attached
source_title: Švenčionių rajone pasieniečiai perėmė ir nutupdė kontrabandininkų lėktuvėlį su cigaretėmis
quote: Švenčionių rajone pasieniečiai perėmė ir nutupdė iš Baltarusijos pusės atskridusį kontrabandininkų lėktuvėlį su cigaretėmis, pranešė Valstybės sienos apsaugos tarnyba (VSAT).
quote_translation: In Švenčionys district border guards intercepted and landed a smugglers' small aircraft with cigarettes that flew in from the Belarusian side, the State Border Guard Service (VSAT) reported.

place: London prisons (Wormwood Scrubs, Brixton, Pentonville, Wandsworth, Norwich, Leicester, Onley, Bedford)
summary: Seven men sentenced at Harrow Crown Court for conspiracy to convey articles into prisons and to supply Class B and C drugs. Police monitoring identified over 50 drone drops in three months. Payload: drugs, phones, chargers, SIM cards.
payload_detail: Class B drugs, mobile phones, chargers, SIM cards
source_title: Drone gang behind majority of London prison drops jailed
quote: The group was so prolific officers believe they were responsible for the majority of drone drops in prisons across London

summary: Two off-duty prison police inspectors spotted and stopped a car with three people piloting a drone over Terni prison; seized 12,000 euro cash and four mobile phones destined for inmates.
payload_detail: 4 mobile phones, 12,000 euro cash
source_title: Terni: intercettati mentre indirizzano drone sul carcere con quattro cellulari e 12mila euro per i detenuti
quote: hanno individuato e bloccato l’auto con a bordo tre soggetti intenti a pilotare il drone in sorvolo sul carcere
quote_translation: identified and stopped the car carrying three people piloting the drone flying over the prison

place: Algeciras and Marbella (Campo de Gibraltar and Costa del Sol)
summary: Policía Nacional dismantled a network introducing hashish from Morocco with large home-built drones made in Ukraine, about 10 kg per flight, range over 50 km. Ten arrested, seven jailed, six searches in Algeciras and Marbella; three aircraft seized. Europol, Ukraine and Poland assisted.
payload_detail: hashish, about 10 kg per flight; one group tried to send up to 1,000 kg
source_title: La Policía Nacional desmantela una red de “narcodrones” que operaba entre España y Marruecos
quote: Agentes de la Policía Nacional han desarticulado en Algeciras una organización criminal dedicada, presuntamente, a la introducción de hachís en nuestro país procedente de Marruecos utilizando aeronaves no tripuladas.
quote_translation: National Police officers have broken up in Algeciras a criminal organisation allegedly dedicated to bringing hashish into Spain from Morocco using unmanned aircraft.

summary: Per Lithuania's Prosecutor General's Office, 33,000 packs of Queen Menthol cigarettes worth over EUR 148,000 were moved from Belarus by drones on the night of 27 October 2024. Two border officers allegedly arranged colleagues' absence. Case sent to court against six defendants, Dec 2025.
payload_detail: 33,000 packs Queen Menthol cigarettes, over EUR 148,000 incl. taxes
source_title: Contraband Smugglers and Two Border Officers to Stand Trial in Lithuania for Drone-Based Cigarette Trafficking
quote: According to the Prosecutor General’s Office, during the night of 27 October last year, 33,000 packs of Queen Menthol cigarettes were transported from Belarus to Lithuania using drones.

summary: Border guards and ESBU detectives seized nine boxes (4,500 packs) of unstamped cigarettes from a car in Uzhhorod; the men were said to intend to move them to Slovakia by drone. No drone recovered.
payload_detail: 4,500 packs
source_title: "Закарпатці планували дроном переправити сигарети до Словаччини": в Ужгороді прикордонники вилучили 4500 пачок сигарет
quote: За наявною інформацією, чоловіки мали намір за допомогою дрона переправити з України до Словаччини партію тютюнових виробів
quote_translation: According to available information, the men intended to move a batch of tobacco products from Ukraine to Slovakia by drone.

summary: Unidentified persons flew a drone near Peqin prison and dropped two packages holding about 380 g hashish and 58 g cocaine; drone and drugs seized; investigation into the senders and the inmates awaiting them.
payload_detail: approx 380 g hashish, 58 g cocaine
source_title: Droni në Burgun e Peqinit/ U hodhën dy pako me 380 gramë hashash, rreth 58 gramë kokainë
quote: Burgjet zbardhin detaje të ngjarjes së ndodhur mbrëmë, ku persona të paidentifikuar lëshuan mjetin fluturues pranë institucionit dhe hodhën prej andej pakot me sende të paligjshme.
quote_translation: The prison service gives details of last evening's event, in which unidentified persons launched the flying vehicle near the institution and dropped the packages of illegal items from it.

summary: Guardia di Finanza GICO of Caltanissetta and Catania arrested two Italians near Caltanissetta prison who intended to use a drone to deliver a backpack of drugs and phones: 10 micro-phones, 2 smartphones, 12 SIM cards, 100 g marijuana, over 150 g hashish. A professional drone and 5,000 euro (pilot's fee) were found in the car.
payload_detail: 10 micro-phones, 2 smartphones, 12 SIMs, 100 g marijuana, >150 g hashish
source_title: Un drone per portare in carcere telefoni e droga: due arresti
quote: ha portato i finanzieri dei GICO di Caltanissetta e Catania, ad individuare e, successivamente, ad arrestare due soggetti di nazionalità italiana che, nei pressi della Casa Circondariale di Caltanissetta, intendevano utilizzare un drone
quote_translation: led GdF GICO officers of Caltanissetta and Catania to identify and then arrest two Italians who, near the Caltanissetta prison, intended to use a drone

place: HMP Winchester and other prisons in England, Scotland and Wales
summary: Kaine Jones, 28, sentenced to six years at Redditch Crown Court for conspiracy to convey prohibited articles into prisons and possession of MDMA with intent to supply. A large drone was found in a van in June 2024; a modified drone crashed at HMP Winchester in August 2024.
payload_detail: phones, tobacco, cannabis, MDMA, iPhones, SIM cards
source_title: Redditch man who lead prison drone drug drop jailed for six years
quote: Their efforts have significantly disrupted the ingress of illicit items into prisons across England, Scotland and Wales.

summary: Police arrested two men in their twenties in a central Brussels building and found a hook-equipped drone, a catapult and six packed parcels marked with nicknames, intended for prisoners. Parcels held phones, some also drugs. A firearm and cannabis resin, cocaine and cash were also found. Both were remanded.
payload_detail: parcels with one or more mobile phones, some also narcotics (7 phones per Brussels Times)
source_title: Arrestation de deux dealers suspectés de livrer des colis à des personnes emprisonnées
quote: un drone téléguidé doté d’un crochet, une catapulte et six colis soigneusement empaquetés pour supporter les chocs, chacun distinguable par l’annotation d’un surnom
quote_translation: a remote-controlled drone fitted with a hook, a catapult and six parcels carefully packed to withstand shocks, each marked with a nickname

summary: Gang whose scouts used heat-seeking-camera drones to find cannabis grows were caught at a Mansfield house with a knife and 250+ plants. Six men sentenced at Nottingham Crown Court for conspiracy to commit robbery, 2y4m to 5 years.
source_title: Gang used drone to find and then steal cannabis grows
quote: Analysis of seized mobile phones showed "scouts" used drones with heat-seeking cameras to find grows, then teams were assembled in London to take the crop.

place: Gela (Caltanissetta); drone deliveries to prisons incl. Agrigento, Messina, Ancona
summary: Operation 'The Wall': Carabinieri executed custody orders on 15 people (Caltanissetta court, DDA request) over drug trafficking and weapons, aggravated by aiding the Rinzivillo mafia family. Offences May 2024 to June 2025; the network used drones to bring drugs and phones into prisons.
payload_detail: hashish, cocaine, some crack; phones
source_title: Mafia e droga, telefonini nelle carceri coi droni, 15 arresti
quote: L'organizzazione utilizzava droni per portare nelle carceri droga e telefonini.
quote_translation: The organisation used drones to bring drugs and phones into prisons.

place: forest area, Kovel district, Volyn Oblast
summary: Border guards detained three men from Turiisk area in woodland as they prepared a catapult-launched fixed-wing drone to carry 360 packs of cigarettes to Poland; two who fled were tracked by a border-guard drone. Drone, laptop, batteries, catapult, cigarettes and car handed to ESBU.
payload_detail: 360 packs of cigarettes
source_title: Переправляли цигарки безпілотником: затримали трьох жителів Турійщини
quote: У ніч на 15 квітня у Ковельському районі під час спроби переправлення цигарок за кордон затримали трьох чоловіків та вилучили у них безпілотник
quote_translation: On the night of 15 April in Kovel district, three men were detained during an attempt to move cigarettes across the border and a drone was seized from them.

summary: A trade union official said parcels are often delivered by drone almost into cells at Merksplas prison, helped by broken windows. No incident, date, arrest or seizure is given.
source_title: Antwerpse cipiers klagen met staking ook staat van gebouwen aan: "Overal ongedierte en asbest"
quote: Met drones worden er daar vaak pakketjes tot bijna letterlijk in de cel geleverd waar de gedetineerden dankzij die kapotte ruiten aan kunnen.
quote_translation: Drones are often used there to deliver packages almost literally into the cell, which inmates can reach thanks to those broken windows.

summary: After 818 kg of cocaine was dumped at sea and drifted ashore in Sejerøbugten, the group searched the coast and sea for it with a boat and a remote-controlled drone bought on 15 March 2024. Recovery failed; police seized the cocaine. Two defendants given 16 years.
payload_detail: 818 kg cocaine, dumped from a vessel and drifted ashore; seized by police
source_title: Tiltale for forsøg på overtrædelse af straffelovens § 191, ved at have forsøgt at modtage og sætte sig i besiddelse af ikke under 818 kg kokain. Påstand om frakendelse af retten til dansk indfødsret og udvisning
quote: retten lægger til grund, at der på Ø blev søgt efter kokainen ved kysten, og at søgningen efter kokain bl.a. skete med den drone, som var købt af Tiltalte 1
quote_translation: the court finds that the coast on Ø was searched for the cocaine, and that the search for cocaine was carried out, among other means, with the drone bought by Defendant 1.

place: Justitieel Complex Zaanstad; prisons in Lelystad and Veenhuizen
summary: Police arrested three men aged 25-32 (Rijsenhout, Amsterdam, Schiedam) suspected of delivering drugs and phones by drone to prisoners on order since 2021. Drones, drugs and drone parts found at homes.
payload_detail: drugs and mobile phones; weapons also mentioned by NH Nieuws
source_title: Arrestaties voor leveren drugs en telefoons met drones in gevangenissen
quote: De politie heeft drie mannen opgepakt die met behulp van drones op bestelling spullen afleverden aan gedetineerden.
quote_translation: The police have arrested three men who used drones to deliver items to inmates on order.

summary: Gardaí were told on 12 Feb 2024 of a drone over Cloverhill Prison, found it on adjacent waste land, and intercepted two men, one holding the controller. The drone carried a copper pipe with 5 deals of heroin worth €587. Karl Widdess, who supplied the drone and stored €181,995, received a fully suspended 3-year sentence on 25 Jul 2025.
payload_detail: 5 deals of heroin, €587
source_title: Grandfather avoids jail over attempted prison drone drug delivery
quote: gardaí were notified on 12 February 2024 that there was a drone flying over Cloverhill prison. The drone tracking system within the prison was able to tell where the drone had originated from.

place: outskirts of a border town, Kovel district, Volyn Oblast
summary: Border guards with the SSU brought down a quadcopter carrying two packages of 22.5 kg hashish in Kovel district; three Volyn residents given notice of suspicion and remanded; drone, drugs and three vehicles seized.
payload_detail: 22.5 kg hashish
source_title: Over 22 kilograms of drugs worth 13 million hryvnias. Border guards in Volyn intercepted a drone carrying hashish
quote: successfully brought down a quadcopter carrying two packages. Subsequent investigation revealed that the packages contained 22.5 kilograms of hashish.

place: Volyn and Lviv oblasts (smugglers' homes and outbuildings)
summary: Border guards with Dozor unit busted a Volyn smuggling group using UAVs to send cigarettes abroad and to watch border patrols; eight UAVs, a hang glider, 2,000+ packs counterfeit tobacco and a 3D-printer drone workshop seized.
payload_detail: 2,000+ packs counterfeit tobacco seized
source_title: Ukraine dismantles hi-tech contraband ring that used drones for smuggling cigarettes and monitoring border patrols
quote: They used UAVs not only to send cigarettes abroad, but also to monitor the actions of border patrols,

summary: Bordeaux authorities reportedly held three people suspected of flying drones carrying cannabis, ecstasy, cocaine, phones and alcohol to Gradignan and other regional prisons; pilot aged 17, brother of an inmate.
source_title: France busts a family drone ring running drugs into several prisons
quote: the illegal aerial delivery operation turned out to be something of a family affair as well.

summary: Oliver Onyeahasi, 26, of Bristol sentenced to 40 months for a low-flying drone delivery of Class A, B and C drugs within HMP Erlestoke grounds on 1 October 2023. Drone, package and discarded controller recovered.
payload_detail: Class A, B and C drugs
source_title: Man who attempted to deliver drugs into prison using drone jailed
quote: Those using drones to smuggle contraband into our prisons will feel the full force of the law.

summary: Gendarmerie dismantled 'Air Colis', a drone delivery ring supplying prisons in western France; four arrested, nine DJI drones seized; orders confirmed via Snapchat; €400 per delivery.
source_title: French police bust startup 'Air Colis' drone deliveries to prisons
quote: a Snapchat-based method of confirming orders emanating from inside the clink.

place: northern border sector, ITPF Sighetu Marmației
summary: Sighetu Marmației border police reported 2,960 packs of Ukrainian cigarettes seized in targeted actions; in one case three small parcels were flown over the border by drone to be collected by a Ukrainian citizen.
payload_detail: three small parcels; 2,960 packs total seized in the actions
source_title: Contrabandă cu drona la frontiera de nord
quote: Într-unul din cazuri, ţigările de contrabandă, ambalate în trei colete de mici dimensiuni, au fost trecute peste frontieră cu o dronă şi urmau a fi preluate de un cetăţean ucrainean.
quote_translation: In one of the cases, the contraband cigarettes, packed in three small parcels, were carried across the border by a drone and were to be collected by a Ukrainian citizen.

summary: Squadra mobile and prison police arrested 13 people for delivering drugs and phones to Enna prison by drone at night, tying packages to a rope and guiding the drone to cell windows. Price list found: 2,500 euro a package, up to 3,500 for two.
payload_detail: 'ingenti quantitativi' of drugs and phones
source_title: Enna: consegnano in carcere droga e cellulari col drone, 13 arresti
quote: Consegnavano in volo ingenti quantitativi di droga e telefoni cellulari all’interno del carcere di Enna.
quote_translation: They delivered by air large quantities of drugs and mobile phones inside Enna prison.

summary: Prison staff spotted a drone over Saint-Gilles prison at about 9 am and intercepted it. A packet on a wire held glue, a phone charger and marijuana. Police were informed; no arrests reported.
payload_detail: marijuana, glue, phone charger
source_title: Un drone transportant de la drogue a été intercepté à la prison de Saint-Gilles
quote: un drone qui était supposé déposer de la drogue à l'intérieur de la prison
quote_translation: a drone that was supposed to drop drugs inside the prison

summary: Carabinieri searches in a DDA Naples inquiry into the Ligato clan found two professional drones (over 5,000 euro, one thermal-camera) at the homes of a boss's son and an associate. A victim of extortion says the son used a drone to send warnings after he stopped paying.
source_title: Telecamere termiche e droni della camorra sequestrati a Caserta. L'ipotesi: usati per controllare il territorio
quote: due droni professionali del valore di oltre cinquemila euro, di cui uno con telecamera termica per uso notturno
quote_translation: two professional drones worth over five thousand euro, one with a thermal camera for night use

summary: National Administration of Penitentiaries director said drones tried to deliver drugs and phones at this prison in 2023; at least one case; the drone was not downed, the user was detained and a criminal file opened.
source_title: Droguri și telefoane aduse cu drona în închisorile din România
quote: S-a întâmplat anul trecut, în penitenciarele din Arad și Rahova. Informațiile au fost confirmate de directorul general al Administrației Naționale a Penitenciarelor, Dan Halchin, la Euronews România
quote_translation: It happened last year, in the Arad and Rahova penitentiaries. The information was confirmed by the director general of the National Administration of Penitentiaries, Dan Halchin, on Euronews Romania.

summary: At about 03:50 a drone flew into a prison yard carrying a small bag on a string towards a cell window, was pulled by inmates, hit the wall and crashed. Drone seized; a phone and five SIM cards were found in a cell. Appeal concerned a search warrant for a suspect's home.
payload_detail: mobile phone and five SIM cards seized in the cell searched after the crash
source_title: 5/23.3JASTB-A.E1
quote: no dia 31/12/2022, cerca das 03h.50m., o drone de marca "…", com a placa identificativa "… sobrevou o pátio do campo da bola do Estabelecimento Prisional …, desceu e entrou no mesmo, com um pequeno saco branco pendurado por um fio, aproximando-se imediatamente da janela da cela
quote_translation: on 31/12/2022, at about 03:50, the drone of make '…', with identification plate '…', flew over the football-pitch yard of Prison …, descended and entered it with a small white bag hanging from a string, approaching the cell window immediately.

place: outskirts of Ternava village, Lviv Oblast (10 km from the border)
summary: Border guards saw men trying to launch four homemade drones carrying 3,600 packs of cigarettes toward Poland; the men fled. Drones flew over 10 km into Poland, where Polish guards found the parcels and detained a man who came to collect.
payload_detail: 3,600 packs unstamped cigarettes; SUV with trailer, launch kit, 4,000 zloty seized
source_title: Переправляли сигарети до Польщі безпілотниками. На Львівщині викрили незаконну схему
quote: Вночі, 7 вересня, прикордонники помітили чоловіків, які намагались переправити сигарети до Польщі за допомогою чотирьох безпілотників.
quote_translation: On the night of 7 September, border guards noticed men trying to move cigarettes to Poland with four drones.

summary: Bieszczady Border Guard heard a drone late on 6 September 2022, located boxes dropped nearby, and detained a 39-year-old Polish man loading six packages (over 1,000 packs of cigarettes, over PLN 15,000) into his car. He was charged with smuggling from Ukraine and confessed.
payload_detail: over 1,000 packs of cigarettes, over PLN 15,000
source_title: Papierosy spadły… z nieba. Przemytnicy wykorzystali drony
quote: Mundurowi zatrzymali Polaka zbierającego pakunki wypełnione nielegalnymi papierosami, które do Polski zostały przerzucone dronem.
quote_translation: Officers detained a Pole collecting packages filled with illegal cigarettes that had been thrown into Poland by drone.

place: HMP Onley, Rugby, and 10 other prisons and young offender institutions
summary: A husband-and-wife pair flew drugs, phones, SIM cards and tobacco into 11 prisons on 78 dates (at least 72 at HMP Onley); over 100 incursions. Police say about 50,000 GBP paid to the pilot was laundered through the wife's account. Jailed for more than seven years combined.
payload_detail: heroin, cocaine, cannabis, steroids, tobacco, phones, SIM cards, chargers
source_title: Smugglers used drone to drop thousands of pounds worth of drugs and contraband into prison near Rugby
quote: Maranay used her bank account to launder nearly £50,000, which her husband had been paid for piloting the drones and delivering the contraband at pre-arranged drop points.

place: Castellar de la Frontera (Cádiz); arrests in Cádiz, Málaga and Ceuta
summary: Policía Nacional dismantled a group building home-made underwater drones at Castellar de la Frontera, able to carry up to 200 kg across the Strait; three underwater drones, six multi-motor aerial drones, 145 kg hashish and EUR 157,370 seized. Eight arrested, six jailed. First Policía Nacional seizure of underwater drones.
payload_detail: 145 kg hashish and 8 kg marijuana seized; underwater drones built for 150-200 kg loads
source_title: La 'fábrica' de drones submarinos capaces de atravesar El Estrecho con 200 kilos de droga
quote: En Castelar de la Frontera, un municipio gaditano de poco más de 3.000 habitantes en la comarca de Campo de Gibraltar, una organización se dedicaba a construir de manera artesanal drones submarinos capaces de cruzar el Estrecho con una carga de hasta 200 kilos de estupefacientes a bordo.
quote_translation: In Castellar de la Frontera, a Cádiz town of just over 3,000 people in the Campo de Gibraltar, an organisation built home-made underwater drones able to cross the Strait carrying up to 200 kilos of narcotics.

summary: Chernivtsi border guards found a take-off site for an improvised aircraft at Budenets and detained two men trying to carry tobacco to Romania; aircraft carried 300 packs per flight; warning shots fired.
payload_detail: capacity 300 packs of cigarettes per flight
source_title: Border guards detained two air smugglers in Bukovina
quote: With the help of an airplane, a Bukovinian and a resident of Transcarpathia tried to transport tobacco products to Romania.

summary: Two men agreed with others to bring alpha-PVP from Russia into Estonia by quadcopter drone; on 14 April 2022 they collected a package (195.1 g substance, 154 g alpha-PVP) from a cache by the Narva border post and were stopped by police. Both convicted under plea agreements.
payload_detail: 195.1 g substance containing 154 g alpha-PVP
quote: leppis varalise kasu saamise eesmärgil kokku Venemaa Föderatsiooni territooriumilt drooni-kvadrokopteri abil Eesti Vabariigi territooriumile suures koguses narkootilise aine Alfa-PVP toimetamise
quote_translation: agreed, for financial gain, on delivering a large quantity of the narcotic Alpha-PVP from the territory of the Russian Federation to Estonian territory by drone-quadcopter.

summary: Contraband brought into PI Leeuwarden for payment by a drone, per the court's sentencing reasoning; offence proven for 2022-03-05. Defendant also convicted of drug dealing and thefts; prison sentence imposed.
payload_detail: 0.54 g MDMA, 10.6 g hashish, one mobile phone
source_title: Rechtbank Noord-Nederland, 07-10-2022, 18/075325-22
quote: Zo heeft hij drugs verkocht, goederen gestolen en deze via Marktplaats te koop aangeboden en heeft hij tegen betaling met een drone contrabande in de P.I. gebracht.
quote_translation: Thus he sold drugs, stole goods and offered them for sale on Marktplaats, and for payment he brought contraband into the prison by drone.

place: Porumbești area, Halmeu sector, Satu Mare County (2 km from the border)
summary: Halmeu border police saw a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel at 23:00 and found two people 2 km from the border loading a black-foil parcel into a car; about 500 packs of cigarettes seized; two Romanian citizens under investigation for smuggling.
payload_detail: approx 500 packs of cigarettes
source_title: Țigări de contrabandă transportate cu drona
quote: În data de 19 februarie a.c., în jurul orei 23.00, polițiștii de frontieră din cadrul Sectorului P.F. Halemu – județul Satu Mare, aflați în misiune de supraveghere a frontierei de stat, au observat, pe direcția localitpții Porumbești, un aparat de zbor de mici dimensiuni (dronă), care transporta un colet.
quote_translation: On 19 February, around 23:00, border police of Halmeu sector, Satu Mare county, on border surveillance duty, observed in the direction of Porumbești a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel.

summary: A drone and a trolley case of contraband cigarettes landed in a resident's yard in Straja, 1 km from the Ukrainian border; Vicovu de Sus police took the case.
source_title: O femeie din Suceava s-a trezit în curte cu un troler plin cu țigări
quote: Femeia din Suceava a găsit în curte un troler plin cu țigări și o dronă. Polițiștii din cadrul Poliției Vicovu de Sus se ocupă în continuare de acest caz.
quote_translation: The Suceava woman found a trolley full of cigarettes and a drone in her yard. Vicovu de Sus police are still handling the case.

summary: Instagram video shows a drone flying over the prison wall and inmates pulling a taped package through a ventilation grate into a cell with string and hook. Package not intercepted; two inmates punished.
payload_detail: contents unconfirmed; witnesses mention phones and cannabis
source_title: Zo hengelen gevangenen met drone afgeleverde drugs en telefoon binnen
quote: contrabande via drones tegen te gaan
quote_translation: to counter contraband via drones

place: Prison (PI, name anonymised in judgment), Netherlands
summary: Prison report cited in summary proceedings on a detainee's placement: phone data and video show a drone dropping at a prison exercise yard, with further drone deliveries ordered. Court treats it as suspicion of continued crime from detention.
payload_detail: ordered: 3 iPhones and EUR 750 of narcotics, to be delivered by drone
source_title: Rechtbank Den Haag, 12-12-2023, C/09/654430 / KG ZA 23-822
quote: Er zijn videobeelden gevonden op deze mobiele telefoon van een drone waarop een dropping op een luchtplaats binnen de P.I. [plaats 3] is te zien
quote_translation: Video footage was found on this mobile phone of a drone, showing a drop onto an exercise yard inside the PI [place 3].

summary: Two camouflaged drones carrying drugs, phones, cables and chargers landed on the prison exercise yard on two nights of one weekend. Nobody arrested; items handed to police.
payload_detail: considerable amount of drugs, several phones, cables, chargers
source_title: Twee drones met daarin drugs en telefoons onderschept op luchtplaats JC Zaanstad
quote: De smokkelwaar is overgedragen aan de politie.
quote_translation: The contraband was handed over to the police.

summary: Border police saw a small aircraft (possible drone) fly from Ukraine toward Vicovu de Sus at 19:15 and return; three abandoned parcels of contraband cigarettes were found in the locality; 11,600 packs seized across the sector in 24 hours, part brought by drone.
payload_detail: 11,600 packs seized in 24 h sector-wide, part by drone (drone share not stated)
source_title: Peste 11.000 de pachete cu țigări de contrabandă, confiscate la frontiera cu Ucraina
quote: O parte din cantitatea de țigări a fost trecută peste frontieră, din Ucraina în România, cu ajutorul unei drone.
quote_translation: Part of the quantity of cigarettes was brought across the border from Ukraine into Romania by a drone.

place: Ukrainian-Polish border, Rivne border division area
summary: Rivne border guards heard an aircraft engine near the Polish border; Polish guards found a drone with 600 packs of cigarettes after an apparent emergency landing; drone and fuel confiscated.
payload_detail: 600 packs of cigarettes
source_title: Borderguards detected drones with cigarettes at the Ukrainian-Polish border
quote: At the same time, Polish borderguards detected an aircraft and 600 packs of cigarettes.

summary: Operation Etxea: Guardia Civil dismantled in November 2021 a Ceuta network passing hashish by drone. On 9 July 2025 the Audiencia de Cádiz (Section VI, Ceuta) convicted all 10 defendants by agreement; four as authors got 3 years 1 day, plus fines. Reported as first such sentence in Spain.
payload_detail: hashish
source_title: Condena pionera en Ceuta contra una red de narcodrones
quote: El tribunal de la Sección VI de la Audiencia de Cádiz en Ceuta ha dictado este miércoles una condena por conformidad para los 10 acusados de formar una red en Ceuta dedicada a pasar hachís en drones.
quote_translation: The Section VI court of the Audiencia de Cádiz in Ceuta today handed down a sentence by agreement on the 10 accused of forming a network in Ceuta dedicated to passing hashish by drone.

place: Slovak-Ukrainian border near Huta/Orikhovytsia (Uzhhorod district, Ukraine side)
summary: Ukrainian border guards found four local residents in a car with 16 drone batteries, laptop, remote controls and thermal imager near Orikhovytsia, Ukraine. Slovak border guards then detained a Slovak citizen on Slovak territory with two packages of tobacco products.
payload_detail: two packages of tobacco products
source_title: Air smuggling: Ukrainian border guards detained alleged drone operators while their Slovak colleagues detained the cigarette recipient
quote: Later, Slovak colleagues reported the detention of their compatriot with two packages of tobacco products on their territory.

summary: Border guards found four local residents in a car with 16 drone batteries, a laptop, remote controls, radios and a thermal imager near Huta; Slovak guards detained a man with two packages of tobacco products.
source_title: Air smuggling: Ukrainian border guards detained alleged drone operators while their Slovak colleagues detained the cigarette recipient
quote: They found 16 batteries for a drone, a laptop, several remote controls and radio sets, a battery charger and a thermal imager in the car.

summary: Contraband brought into PI Leeuwarden for payment by a drone, per the court's sentencing reasoning; offence proven for 2021-10-04. Defendant also convicted of drug dealing and thefts; prison sentence imposed.
payload_detail: 7.01 g MDMA, 4.74 g hashish
source_title: Rechtbank Noord-Nederland, 07-10-2022, 18/075325-22
quote: Zo heeft hij drugs verkocht, goederen gestolen en deze via Marktplaats te koop aangeboden en heeft hij tegen betaling met een drone contrabande in de P.I. gebracht.
quote_translation: Thus he sold drugs, stole goods and offered them for sale on Marktplaats, and for payment he brought contraband into the prison by drone.

summary: A detainee fired a pistol inside Frosinone prison on 9 Sept 2021; investigators identified the man who introduced the weapon into the prison by drone, part of the network later arrested in Naples (March 2024).
payload_detail: pistol
source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
quote: L’attività degli investigatori riuscì a identificare l’uomo che aveva introdotto l’arma all’interno del carcere utilizzando un drone.
quote_translation: The investigators' work succeeded in identifying the man who had introduced the weapon into the prison using a drone.

place: Halmeu, Satu Mare County (orchard 1,500 m from the Ukrainian border)
summary: Halmeu border police saw a small drone carrying a parcel at 23:30 and found about 3,000 packs of cigarettes wrapped in black foil in an orchard 1,500 m from the border; a Romanian citizen who was to store them is under investigation.
payload_detail: approx 3,000 packs of cigarettes
source_title: Contrabandă cu țigări din Ucraina, cu drona, peste graniță
quote: În data de 11.08.2021, în jurul orei 23.30, poliţiştii de frontieră din cadrul Sectorului P.F. Halmeu – judeţul Satu Mare, aflaţi în misiune de supraveghere a frontierei de stat, au observat, pe direcţia localităţii Halmeu, un aparat de zbor de mici dimensiuni (dronă), care transporta un colet.
quote_translation: On 11.08.2021, around 23:30, border police of Halmeu sector, Satu Mare county, on border surveillance duty, observed in the direction of Halmeu a small aircraft (drone) carrying a parcel.

summary: Operation Piñas, run by French and Spanish police under a European Investigation Order. Three people were arrested in France with 12 kg of hashish; a fourth was detained in Málaga with a drone with a 4.35 m wingspan and seven-hour flight capacity, modified to carry drugs from Morocco.
payload_detail: 12 kg hashish seized in France
source_title: Franco-Spanish raid busts criminals using souped-up drone to transport drugs
quote: Authorities said the criminals had modified the drone to be able to transport drugs from Morocco to Malaga.

summary: A woman flew a drone package to a third-floor cell window at HMP Peterborough: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco. Police put the prison value at 5,800 GBP (cannabis) and 3,000 GBP (tobacco). One-year sentence suspended for two years, 150 hours unpaid work.
payload_detail: 10 miniature phones, cannabis, tobacco, cigarette papers
source_title: Woman used drone to smuggle phones and drugs into HMP Peterborough
quote: Prison officers were alerted to the drone flying within the grounds and witnessed it approach a third-floor window where the occupant took it through a hole in his window.

summary: Kuźnica Border Guard patrol saw a drone from Belarus drop a load 900 m from the border and turn back. Three people collecting it fled by car; the Polish driver tried to ram officers. 2,000 packs of unstamped cigarettes (about PLN 30,000) seized; two Belarusians and one Pole charged.
payload_detail: 2,000 packs cigarettes without Polish excise stamps, nearly PLN 30,000
source_title: Udaremniono przemyt przy użyciu drona
quote: Patrol Straży Granicznej z Kuźnicy zauważył lecący obiekt z Białorusi do Polski. Ustalono, że był to bezzałogowy statek powietrzny tzw. dron, który w odległości 900 metrów od granicy państwa zrzucił ładunek i zawrócił na Białoruś.
quote_translation: A Border Guard patrol from Kuźnica noticed an object flying from Belarus to Poland. It was established to be an unmanned aircraft, a so-called drone, which dropped its load 900 metres from the border and turned back to Belarus.

summary: Commissariato Vicaria Mercato arrested a 43-year-old under house arrest who used a drone from his terrace to monitor police and Carabinieri movements; 130 g heroin and 1,755 euro found. Investigators did not rule out drone deliveries to customers.
payload_detail: 130 g heroin (found at home, not on the drone)
source_title: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote: Napoli: usava un drone per controllare spostamenti di Polizia e Carabinieri, pusher arrestato
quote_translation: Naples: used a drone to monitor Police and Carabinieri movements, pusher arrested

place: Rivne section, Lutsk Border Detachment, Volyn Oblast
summary: Around midnight border guards found a UAV and a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes prepared for transfer to the Polish side; a separate patrol found 2,000 packs moved from Belarus by a purpose-built device.
payload_detail: 500 packs prepared for transfer
source_title: На Волині затримали безпілотник, який мав перевезти сигарети до Польщі (фото)
quote: близько опівночі військовослужбовці відділу «Рівне», реалізовуючи оперативну інформацію, виявили в прикордонні безпілотний літальний апарат. Поряд знаходився пакунок з 500 пачками сигарет
quote_translation: around midnight, servicemen of the Rivne unit, acting on operational information, found an unmanned aerial vehicle in the border area. Next to it was a parcel of 500 packs of cigarettes.

place: Naples base; deliveries to 18 prisons incl. Secondigliano, Frosinone, Cosenza, Siracusa, Augusta, Catania, Rovigo, Trapani, Saluzzo, Sulmona
summary: Naples DDA operation: 31 people subject to two custody orders (20 + 11, Polizia di Stato and prison police). Network supplied phones, drugs and firearms to prisons by drone, paid by camorra organisations; investigation began April 2021. A 52-year-old modified drones to carry more weight.
payload_detail: phones, drugs, firearms (quantities not in release)
source_title: Armi, droga e telefoni in carcere con i droni, 31 arresti a Napoli
quote: Tentativo di introduzione di materiale illecito sventato
quote_translation: Attempt to introduce illicit material foiled

summary: Second of three attempts to deliver drugs into HMP Gartree, by drone, arranged between an outside associate and an inmate using a phone. Unsuccessful. Associate arrested 13 Oct 2021; sentenced 28 Jun 2024 to 5 years consecutive on the prison-conveyance count.
payload_detail: unquantified Class A and B drugs; attempt unsuccessful
source_title: R v Mohammed Jakir Hussain [2025] EWCA Crim 419
quote: The second attempt took place on 31 March 2021, this time involving the use of a drone. The appellant and the inmate discussed test flights and used internet searches to research the payload and how to modify the device to make less noise when being used to deliver drugs into the prison.

summary: Policía Nacional and Guardia Civil dismantled a Ceuta network passing hashish from Morocco by drone; four arrested and drones seized. Local press calls it the first such operation in Spain.
payload_detail: hashish
source_title: Operación conjunta, buenos resultados
quote: Ceuta fue escenario ayer de una operación pionera en España que ha desmantelado una red dedicada al pase de hachís en narcodrones.
quote_translation: Ceuta was yesterday the scene of an operation, a first in Spain, that has dismantled a network dedicated to passing hashish by narco-drone.

place: St John's Square near Portlaoise Prison, Co. Laois
summary: Gardaí seized a drone with a package of phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis (about €5,000) near Portlaoise Prison and arrested a man in his 20s. He was charged on 8 Jan 2021 and bailed on condition he not fly drones near places of detention.
payload_detail: mobile phones, chargers, crack cocaine, cocaine, cannabis; est. €5,000
source_title: Drone and drugs seized by Garda in Portlaoise 6/1/21 arrest
quote: Gardaí have arrested a man in his 20s following the seizure of a drone along with a package containing mobile phones, chargers and quantities of crack cocaine, cocaine and cannabis, with a combined estimated value of €5,000 (analysis pending).

summary: Police found a group receiving alpha-PVP sent by drone from Ivangorod, Russia, across the Narva river into Narva; six such deliveries were found in the investigation and the group was caught on the sixth. Four people were suspected, three in custody.
payload_detail: alpha-PVP (quantity not stated)
source_title: Politsei tabas mullu Narvas kaks droone kasutanud salakaubavedajate gruppi
quote: Narkootikumid saadeti Ivangorodist drooniga üle Narva jõe Narva linna. Meie avastasime kriminaalmenetluse käigus kuus sellist korda. Kuuendal korral pidasime nad kinni.
quote_translation: The drugs were sent from Ivangorod by drone across the Narva river to the town of Narva. We found six such occasions in the criminal proceedings. On the sixth occasion we detained them.

place: HMP Onley, Rugby, and HMP Gartree, Leicestershire
summary: Three men jailed at Wolverhampton Crown Court (6y6m, 5y6m, 7y3m) and a former Staffordshire Police detective constable given a suspended two-year sentence, for drone drops of drugs, tobacco and phones into HMP Onley and HMP Gartree in 2021-2022.
payload_detail: Class A and B drugs, tobacco, phones; one package heroin and cannabis
source_title: Smugglers jailed for using drones to drop contraband into prison near Rugby
quote: Let this case send a clear message to anyone thinking of engaging in similar behaviour

summary: Hungarian tax and customs authority (NAV) and police met smugglers using drones and unmanned aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian green border, tracked them by thermal camera, and seized over 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two aircraft.
payload_detail: more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes
source_title: Cigarettacsempészet drónnal
quote: A légi eszközöket az orgazdák az ukrán-magyar határnál vetették be, a pénzügyőrök pedig hőkamerákkal követték útjukat. Ennek eredményeképpen több mint 6700 doboz cigarettát és két gépet találtak és foglaltak le.
quote_translation: The smugglers used the aircraft at the Ukrainian-Hungarian border and customs officers tracked them with thermal cameras. As a result, more than 6,700 boxes of cigarettes and two machines were found and seized.

place: Prisons in Veenhuizen, Almelo and Krimpen aan den IJssel (also other NL/BE institutions)
summary: Dordrecht court convicted a 34-year-old man from Rijsenhout under procedural agreements for drone drops of phones and drugs at prisons in 2021, 2023 and 2024. Drone and nearly 130 g MDMA found at his home. Two co-suspects not prosecuted.
payload_detail: phones and drugs; nearly 130 g MDMA at home
source_title: OM eist straf voor droppen telefoons en drugs bij gevangenissen
quote: Drones vormen in toenemende mate een serieuze bedreiging voor de orde en veiligheid in penitentiaire inrichtingen.
quote_translation: Drones increasingly pose a serious threat to order and security in penal institutions.
